text:
[LADP.3.4.1] For a regex-constrained pattern, the Rete engine fires one activation
per matching fact — the natural all-match semantic. A rule with
`Sensor t where t.entity_id ~ /_temp$/ and t.state > 75` activates independently
for each `Sensor` fact whose `entity_id` matches and whose state is
above 75. Bindings scope to each activation.
